title: the holdback tooling patch

banner.title: the holdback tooling patch - the second tooling round of the regtest decomposition arc
banner.provenance: spec-driven; the engine head walk widens 800 to 4000 so the sixteen no-head blocks (the WSG weather pair, the DMO family, the MM2 letter walks - heads 823 to 2325 lines above their labels) find their heads, and the migrate key gains a per-block allow_wide tolerance so the thirty-one width-family blocks (77 wide code lines, 79 to 159 cols; regtest itself runs to 305) move verbatim instead of split; the 78-col default stands for every undeclared block; no block moves this round - the tooling lands alone, the final 55-block batch closes the arc
